second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (61 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 2 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side prints label 51 twice (q051, q051b); 64 questions. Answer side 1-25, [match block, 10 rows], 27-62 aligned by printed number (key 51 fits the first q51, key 52 fits q052): q051b and q063 have no key. Difficulty per question: easy 41, average 4, difficult 19, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 38 (heading, LO, q1-5) 39-42; A pdf 142 (heading 'Lesson 9 : Food habits', keys 1-12) 143-145.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25 (answer-space dashes removed; q24 prints none); s4 '26. Match the following appropriately (easy)' q26 (10 rows; Q-side labels garbled e)/(j)); s5 one mark q27-36 vsa; s6 two marks q37-45 sa; s7 three marks q46-53 sa (incl. q051b); s8 four marks q54-63 la.

NUMBERING: label 51 printed twice (pdf 41: '51. Explain the importance of cleanliness…' and '51.Give a comparison of the food of other regions…') -> q051, q051b (v1.4 §14.1). The answer side prints one '51.' whose text fits q051 and continues 52, 53 … fitting q052 onwards by printed number — no displaced band; q051b has no printed key ('no answer printed').
q34 stem merges a fragment ('do people follow different food habits.') with the question — flagged. q063 refers to a picture of the fair that is not printed — flagged, 'no answer printed'.
Keys: one-line prose keys verbatim, wrapped prose joined; q48 key a list of 6 printed lines (6 steps); q29, q42, q46, q50, q57 print example/sample answers as printed.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_09.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
